intro: Loan types buyers ask about. This demo does not quote rates, credit scores, or down payments.

items.title: Conventional
items.body: A standard mortgage path for buyers who meet typical credit and down-payment guidelines. Your lender sets the numbers.

items.title: FHA
items.body: A government-backed option that can help some buyers with lower down payments. We connect you with a lender you choose.

items.title: VA
items.body: Benefits for eligible military service members and veterans. Eligibility and terms come from your lender and the VA.

items.title: USDA
items.body: Zero-down options may be available in eligible rural areas. A lender confirms whether a property qualifies.

items.title: Self-employed
items.body: Documentation looks different when you run your own business. We stay in step with your lender on what they need.
